last_episode_to_air.overview: At court, JACK attacks HONG and YU who did not witness HENG shot at BEN. HONG and YU’s testimonies are only wild guess. NAM bought BEN the “Pillow Stuffing”. She is shocked to see FU and BEN has woken up. BEN appears at court. LUN asks BEN who had shot him. BEN claims that both brothers were trying to rescue him. HENG thinks that BEN has given him too much protection while HONG believes BEN has taken up too much responsibility. HONG visits HENG in the prison. HONG and HENG eventually reconcile. TSUI arrives and expresses that she will wait for him to name their baby. HENG is glad. NAM visits BEN who is in the hospital. She is shocked to see BEN and FU are embracing each other. NAM receives a call from BEN. She reckons that BEN will propose a break up. BEN proposes to marry NAM with her beloved pendant. NAM refuses BEN. BEN follows NAM home. Her family members refuse to let BEN in. BEN expresses his love to NAM. NAM is moved.… ...

name: Golden Faith
overview: Golden Faith is a TVB drama released in 2002 starring a cast that includes a strong mix of new generation actors such as Gallen Lo, Deric Wan, Jessica Hsuan, Raymond Lam, Anne Heung, Myolie Wu, Tavia Yeung and Michelle Ye and old generation powerhouse actors such as Paul Chun, Lau Dan, Shek Sau, Kwok Fung, Lau Kong and Gigi Wong. It is Gallen Lo's final dramatic epic before he left TVB, Deric Wan's comeback drama, Myolie Wu's breakthrough role and Felix Lok's first major role from random support characters. It is billed as a major production from the makers of At the Threshold of an Era.
